call_points.text: Multi-year policies account for close to 50% of fresh business.
Renewal book is operating at less than 100% combined ratio.
Equity allocation is capped internally at 15% of AUM, currently sitting at ~14%.
Hospital package pricing accounts for close to 80% of total claims.
Added 39,000 new agents in H1 FY27, taking agency network to 8.7 lakh.
Sub-debt of ₹400 crores closed, with a balance of ₹70 crores scheduled to be completed by November 2026.
Loss ratio improved for the third successive quarter down 4% YoY to 65.2% in Q4 FY26.
Fresh retail growth for the quarter was 38% YoY driven by both value and volume.
Mark-to-market losses on equity investments reached ₹558 crore during the quarter due to geopolitical tensions.

guidance.statement: Insurance revenue growth to reach 15-16% through FY27 and rise further in FY28
Expense ratio improvement of 30-40 bps a year
Net reinsurance cost to fall to 0.5-0.6% from about 0.9% in FY26
Steady-state ROE of mid- to high-teens
Aspire to grow fresh business at 20%+ consistently over a long period

operating_notes.text: Star Health settled ~30 Lakh claims amounting to ₹11,900+ Crores during FY26 with 99% Persistency.
Star Health new-to-insurance customers accounted for 94% of fresh additions in H2 FY26.
Health insurance industry typically witnesses higher claims during monsoon period due to rainy season related diseases
Long-term policies are about 40% of fresh retail premium, which delays revenue recognition over 2-3 years.
Agency network reached 8.5 lakh agents after adding about 20,000 in Q1FY27, with agent productivity up 19% YoY.
D2C fresh business grew 142% YoY, with 98% of those customers new to insurance.
Agent count reached 8.7 lakh as of September 30, 2026.
Added 39,000 agents in H1 FY27 taking agency force to 8.7 lakh, with agent productivity up 19% YoY.
Settled 22.5 lakh claims during H1 FY27 with retail claims settlement ratio improving to 92.4%.
Multi-year policies account for close to 50% of fresh retail business.
Equity allocation is capped internally at 15% of AUM (currently ~14%).
Proprietary channels (agency and digital D2C) contribute >90% of retail health business.

timeline.summary: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited scheduled Q4 & FY2026 earnings call for April 29, 2026, at 08:30 AM IST with **Anand Roy (MD & CEO), Amitabh Jain (ED & COO), Himanshu Walia (ED & CMO), Nilesh Kambli (CFO), Aneesh Srivastava (CIO), and Sombit Bhattacharyya (Head-IR)**.
Star Health received exchange no-objections for promoter reclassification of Ebano Private Limited and GS E-Commerce Private Limited on April 27, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹4,327.15 Cr (+13.9% YoY), net profit ₹111.33 Cr (+21729.4% YoY).
Star Health reported FY26 PAT of ₹911 Cr (+16% YoY) and GWP of ₹20,369 Cr with a combined ratio of 98.8%.
Star Health reported Q4 FY26 GWP of ₹6,259 Cr (+17% YoY) and full year GWP crossing ₹20,369 Cr, with an underwriting profit of ₹186 Cr for the quarter.
Safecrop Investments India LLP, the Promoter of Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited, declared no encumbrance on its shares during FY2026, signed by SUMIR CHADHA CHADHA on April 07, 2026.
Rekha Jhunjhunwala, as nominee of Late Mr. Rakesh Jhunjhunwala, confirmed no encumbrances on STAR Health’s shares during FY 2025-26.

Star Health reported Q1FY27 results with PAT of ₹550 Cr and CISR of 97.0%, reflecting improved underwriting and investment performance.
